title: Assay of phagocytic function in primary murine microglia
protocol: Dissociate neural progenitor cells in 0.1M PBS + 2mg/ml papain at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Treat dissociated neural progenitor cells with UV light for 15-20 minutes in a thin plastic petri dish.
Wash neural progenitor cells in 40 ml PBS at room temperature, spin at 1200 RPM for 7 minutes at room temperature with low brake.
Decant the supernatant.
Resuspend neural progenitor cells in 5 ml of room temperature 0.1M PBS.
Add 5 μl sta 5(6)-TAMRA, SE to neural progenitor cells, vortex immediately and incubate at 37°C in the dark for 15 minutes.
Wash three times with 40 ml ice-cold 0.1M PBS as described in step 3.
Resuspend in 1 ml DMEM/F12 + Anti-anti.
Count cells using a hemacytometer and dilute or concentrate to achieve a concentration of 5 X 10^6 per ml.
Feed microglial cells onto glass cover slips in DMEM/F12 + 10% fetal bovine serum + Anti-anti at a ratio of 10 NPC:1 microglial cell.
Place the plates in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Remove plates from the incubator at desired timepoints (e.g., one, two, and five hours).
In a sterile hood, remove cover slips with forceps and dip them briskly in warm 0.1M PBS to remove non-phagocytosed NPC.
Place cover slips in 1 ml of 4% PFA in a 24-well plate for fixation.
Fix cells on cover slips in the dark for 20 minutes.
Wash cover slips three times with 0.1M PBS at room temperature (RT).
Block cover slips in 10% serum in PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 and 0.5% BSA, incubating for one hour at RT in the dark.
Incubate cover slips with anti-CD11b (eBioscience) diluted 1:100 for one hour at RT in the dark.
Wash cover slips three times with 0.1M PBS at RT.
Incubate cover slips with secondary antibody (diluted 1:1000, Invitrogen) for one hour at RT.
Wash cover slips once with 0.1M PBS at RT.
Incubate cover slips in DAPI diluted 1:20,000 for five minutes.
Wash cover slips three times with 0.1M PBS at RT.
Mount cover slips on slides using Aqua-Mount (Lerner Laboratories).
Let the slides dry overnight before imaging.
Calculate the "phagocytic index" by dividing the total area of microglial cells (CD11b+) by the total area of labeled neural progenitor cells (NPC).
Alternatively, quantify phagocytosis using the number of phagocytosed targets per cell.
Image Z-stacks on a confocal microscope to distinguish between internalized and adhered targets.
